Ensure investigations are conducted thoroughly, objectively, confidentially, and in accordance with organizational policies and regulatory expectations. Track and trend investigation activity to identify recurring operational, compliance, and patient safety risks. Root Cause Analysis & Operational Improvement Perform detailed root cause analyses to identify underlying process failures, operational breakdowns, and systemic vulnerabilities contributing to events or allegations. Develop actionable recommendations and corrective action plans aimed at reducing future risk exposure and improving operational performance. Collaborate with operational leaders to implement process improvements and monitor effectiveness of mitigation strategies. Identify trends and emerging risk areas requiring proactive intervention or monitoring. review_candidates.title: Architect
review_candidates.description: Role Description The Architect is responsible for developing architectural concepts, preparing design proposals, and coordinating building design activities to create functional, safe, and visually appealing spaces. This role combines creative design, spatial planning, technical documentation, material selection, regulatory coordination, and project collaboration to ensure that architectural solutions align with project objectives, design standards, and client requirements. Design responsibilities include developing architectural concepts, preparing preliminary layouts, evaluating spatial arrangements, and producing design presentations for residential, commercial, institutional, or other building projects. The architect considers functionality, accessibility, aesthetics, sustainability, and efficient use of space when developing design solutions. Duties also include reviewing design requirements, evaluating site information, selecting suitable materials, and refining architectural proposals based on project specifications and stakeholder feedback. Technical documentation responsibilities involve preparing floor plans, elevations, sections, construction details, schedules, and other architectural drawings. The architect ensures that design documents are clear, accurate, coordinated, and consistent with relevant technical requirements. Additional duties include reviewing drawings, updating design revisions, maintaining project documentation, and coordinating architectural information with structural, mechanical, electrical, and other technical disciplines. The role also supports the preparation of design specifications, presentation materials, and documentation required for project submissions and approvals. Project coordination responsibilities include communicating with clients, consultants, contractors, suppliers, and internal project teams to support the successful development of architectural designs. The architect participates in design meetings, reviews project progress, addresses design-related queries, and coordinates revisions when requirements change. Duties may also include reviewing construction documentation, assessing proposed material substitutions, monitoring design consistency, and supporting site inspections or construction reviews where required. The architect helps identify design conflicts and contributes to practical solutions that balance visual quality, technical feasibility, budget considerations, and project schedules. The role also involves reviewing applicable building regulations, planning requirements, accessibility standards, and sustainability principles to support compliant architectural outcomes. The architect evaluates design alternatives, incorporates appropriate environmental considerations, and seeks opportunities to improve energy efficiency and material utilization. Through thoughtful design development, accurate technical documentation, and effective multidisciplinary coordination, the architect contributes to high-quality built environments that meet functional needs and project expectations. Qualifications Degree in Architecture or a closely related architectural design discipline. Understanding of architectural design principles, spatial planning, building systems, and construction methods. Knowledge of architectural drawings, floor plans, elevations, sections, construction details, and design documentation. Familiarity with architectural design software such as AutoCAD, Revit, SketchUp, or other relevant modeling and drafting tools. Understanding of building codes, planning regulations, accessibility requirements, and applicable design standards. Ability to develop design concepts, evaluate spatial layouts, and prepare clear architectural presentations. Knowledge of construction materials, building finishes, detailing, and sustainable design principles. Strong visual, spatial, and technical reasoning abilities. Excellent attention to detail when preparing drawings, reviewing specifications, and coordinating design revisions. Strong written and verbal communication skills for presenting design ideas and coordinating project requirements. Ability to collaborate with clients, consultants, contractors, and multidisciplinary project teams. Effective organizational and time-management skills when managing design tasks and project deadlines. Analytical and problem-solving abilities to identify design conflicts and develop practical solutions. Commitment to design quality, technical accuracy, safety, sustainability, and compliance with applicable requirements. Ability to adapt to changing project specifications and contribute to continuous improvement throughout the design process.
